tools.name: sql
tools.description: Run one SQL statement on your working copy of the database (a branch). Reads see your own changes; writes never reach the real data until a person accepts them. One statement per call. Upserts (INSERT ... ON CONFLICT) are not supported unless the server has gnomon's C module: write an UPDATE, then an INSERT ... SELECT ... WHERE NOT EXISTS. Results are cut at a row limit; `truncated` says when.

reason.description: why, for writes: kept with the change

tools.name: describe
tools.description: Describe the database: tables you can read, their columns and keys, foreign keys both ways, which tables you can change, masked columns, row estimates. Call it before writing SQL.

tools.name: diff
tools.description: What you have changed so far, field by field.

tools.name: dry_run
tools.description: Try statements without keeping them: returns the changes they would make, the checks and any error. Nothing is kept.

tools.name: checkpoint
tools.description: Remember the current state of your changes under a name, to rewind to it later.

tools.name: rewind
tools.description: Undo every change you made since a checkpoint.

tools.name: done
tools.description: Say you are finished: a person reviews your changes and accepts or rejects them. Summarize what you did and why.
